```artifact
Feature: System Requirements for Consultation Requests and Patient Management

  Scenario: System should handle 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years
    Given the system is designed to handle a database of 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    When the system processes 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years
    Then the system should not fail and should maintain performance

  Scenario: System should cater to up to 250,000 unique Patients
    Given the system is designed to handle up to 250,000 unique Patients
    When the system provisions 250,000 unique Patients
    Then the system should not fail and should maintain performance

  Scenario Outline: System should support up to 5 specialities by end of year 3
    Given the system is designed to support <specialities_count> specialities
    When the system is configured with <specialities_count> specialities
    Then the system should not fail and should maintain performance
    Examples:
      | specialities_count |
      | 1                  |
      | 5                  |
      | 6                  |

  Scenario: System should be designed for future growth
    Given the system is designed with scalability in mind
    When the system is subjected to increased load beyond current capacity
    Then the system should handle the increased load without failure

  Scenario: System should be capable of running on a mobile platform (Android)
    Given the system is designed to be mobile-compatible
    When the system is accessed on an Android device
    Then the system should function correctly and provide a responsive user interface

  Scenario: System should have adaptive response in user interfaces
    Given the system is designed with adaptive response in mind
    When the system is accessed on devices with different screen sizes
    Then the system should adjust the user interface to fit the screen size

  Scenario: System should have user-friendly font sizes and ease of use
    Given the system is designed with usability in mind
    When a user interacts with the system
    Then the system should have font sizes that are easy to read and the interface should be easy to navigate
```
